text:
No hiring choice can be put forward yet, because the £400k annual-salary limit was not checkable in this analysis.

- The comparison is **very fragile** and rests partly on Olumi-authored estimates, including onboarding effects; delivery capacity is the most sensitive user-provided assumption.
- The model compared hiring **2 seniors**, **4 juniors**, current staffing, and a mixed option, but did not establish whether any stays under **£400k/year**.
- The constraint was withheld because annual salary spend is modelled as a change, not a salary figure in £/year; the goal direction was also not explicitly stated.
